observations: Photo 0 shows the open interior of a refrigerator: empty white liner, two wire shelves, door swung open to the right, watermark text across the lower door.

Photo 1 shows the exterior of a silver two-door refrigerator with top fridge and bottom freezer sections, a blue shield sticker reading "No.1" on the upper door, and a cardboard box labeled "NEW SILVER CREST" on the floor beside it.

claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show a refrigerator
photos cannot show cooling operation or compressor function
exterior appears clean but hidden damage, odors, or liner cracks cannot be ruled out from photos

risks.risk: Refrigerator does not cool or compressor is faulty
risks.proof: video of the unit plugged in with compressor running and interior temperature dropping

risks.risk: Door gasket or seal is torn and not sealing properly
risks.proof: close-up photo of the closed door gasket with a light-leak test

risks.risk: Power plug or cord is damaged or incompatible with Nigerian sockets
risks.proof: photo of the plug and power cord

risks.risk: Interior liner has cracks or persistent odors not visible in current angles
risks.proof: additional interior photos from all corners and angles
risks.if_unproven: as fair condition with possible hidden defects

proof_requests: Video of the refrigerator plugged in and cooling
Photo of the power plug and cord
More interior photos from all angles
response.reason: The item is clearly a two-door refrigerator; because the seller's claim that it works perfectly is unproven, it is priced at its worst case as not working pending proof.
